name: Spotted-Bamboo Umbrella (Tương Phi Tán)
lore: Spotted bamboo from Tương Phi Đảo and oiled paper, made for Phó Tiêu Tương in 380 (legendary tuong_phi_tan). The spots on the ribs are said to be tears. Mạnh Dạ Vũ took it in 880 (C164) and proclaimed the Night Rain Edict under it in 905 (C167). On the ridge it is the only thing the lightning will not touch. Its spotted-bamboo spine sheathes a blade as thin as a rib, the blade his master never drew: the umbrella's rule stands while it is open, and the blade is drawn for the one cut.
build_use: The head's guard: defence, evasion and linh lực, and the umbrella turns the Thunder that his own root cannot hold; the blade in its spine is his one late cut (a flying sword, base phi_kiem).

name: The Founder's Rain-Chain (Tổ Sư Vũ Liên)
lore: Nine bronze cups on a chain, the first rain-chain, hung by the founder from the eaves of her tower on the cone in 380 (N-thinh_vu-01). It has never been taken down. Quan Vũ Thanh wears its spare links at her belt and calls the chain itself hers to keep, not to carry. The Tower says the chain is where the founder listens.
build_use: The first elder's sustain and her claim: the third piece of the Regalia.

name: Lamp of the Soul Vaults (Hồn Khố Đăng)
lore: The master lamp of the soul vaults, the only lamps the Tower has lit since 906 (A274). One small lamp burns in the vaults for every sworn member, holding a thread of their soul. This one burns for all of them. Lệ Tiêu Hồn's father made the bronze in Thanh Đăng Trấn before the lamp-makers left (V148).
build_use: The vault master's curses, with soul damage and sight.
